name: Tanla Platforms Ltd
title: Tanla Platforms Ltd - 532790 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Tanla's CPaaS volumes grow faster than price in SMS, with OTT revenue share flat near 31-32%, and management offers no quantified guidance; margins described as range-bound with a ₹12 crore FX loss.

triggers.label: SMS price pressure, volumes outpace
triggers.quote: There is some stress on the pricing. Although it has not declined significantly, but there is pricing pressure.

triggers.label: Bandhan Bank ATP deal went live
triggers.quote: We added the third bank, which is Bandhan Bank. So, we already integrated. We went live with them.

triggers.label: UAE subsidiary closure promised this quarter
triggers.quote: effectively, we should be able to close the deal in this quarter. Let me commit that.

guidance.value: CPaaS industry growth 8-10%; Tanla share gain at more than 10% a year
guidance.quote: it's going to be definitely more than 10% a year

guidance.value: Rs 100-150 crore per annum to continue
guidance.quote: is that trajectory expected to continue in the future, ₹100 crores to ₹150 crores per annum capex?

guidance.value: Close in current quarter, ~Rs 150-170 crore top line at ~22% gross margin
guidance.quote: we should be able to close the deal in this quarter. Let me commit that.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Third ATP bank deal by March
prior_guidance_check.quote: we have signed the third deal. In fact, we went live last month.

red_flags.label: FX loss ₹12 crore, hedging gap
red_flags.quote: this one is more of a specific, liability bala nce sheet item, which got restated

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on guidance and split-up
red_flags.quote: we don't actually issue any forward-looking statements.

red_flags.label: UAE deal delayed ~3 years
red_flags.quote: it's just stuck at a RBI level because there are some old matters which had to be clarified

evasions.topic: Platform segment FY27/FY28 growth targets and locked-in share
